billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Billing cycles generated for subscriptions across the platform.

actions.processDescription: Start processing this billing cycle? A billing attempt will be opened.
actions.retryDescription: Retry this failed billing cycle? A new billing attempt will be opened.
actions.cancelDescription: Cancel this billing cycle? This cannot be undone.
actions.skipDescription: Skip this billing cycle without processing it?
actions.markSucceededDescription: Mark this billing cycle as manually succeeded?
actions.markFailedDescription: Mark this billing cycle as manually failed?
actions.reasonTooLong: Reason must be at most 160 characters.
actions.failureCodeTooLong: Failure code must be at most 100 characters.
actions.failureMessageTooLong: Failure message must be at most 2000 characters.

form.createDescription: Open a new billing cycle for a subscription. Amount is derived automatically from the subscription's price.
